scope: Independent review of preserved ordinary API requests, raw responses, write bodies, read receipts, process exits, and artifact identities. No product edit, build, node, test, or existing helper execution by this reviewer.

source.head: fca23b6ff69613adc42d683dd95e071c861c61f7
source.private_copy_limit: All five temporary roots are absent before this reviewer's final private-copy read. The preserved inputs for every run record the same source and binary identity. The unchanged constructor copies and hashes the private binary, and the root reports its explicit pre-run private-program hash guard. This reviewer does not claim a direct post-run private-copy hash.

accepted_request_data.transport: Keyed queries use batches. Administrative queries use the single route with at most four independent calls in parallel.

actual_response_review: Nullable source reads retain their other fields and return email=null. Old optional peer keys return no records. Later Delete removes the addressed source.
Old-source Delete, Purge, and key moves preserve the later collision peer's complete requested fields for Hash and HashRange.

The moved source and new peer key expose move-one, move-new, and equal-value. Repeated effective-key and cross-schema private updates expose P2 at G-same and G-cross, while E-same and E-cross are absent.
Mapped Page and Sample return only target/r. Mapped range reads return only g/R with left=L and right=R; the exact g/L read is absent. Requested mapped counts equal 1.
Descending equal-range pages return a, then b, then c. The total is 3; only the third page reports exhaustion.

All these observations match before and after process reopen. The 23 actual query response files have identical keys, fields, counts, and exhaustion across both encoding modes after exclusion of per-home metadata.

existing_write_cohort.flush_state: Every flush has writer_failed=false, accepted_batches=0, accepted_batch=false, equal accepted/completed sequence, and core_warm_dirty=0.
existing_write_cohort.note: Different record revisions are intentional in the mixed independent-key batch. Each concurrent full-replacement response uses one permitted complete revision.

preserved_nonaccepted_attempts.cause: Both attempts send administrative queries through the batch route. That route deliberately removes the administrative override header. These are operation setup refusals, and neither attempt proves all requested behavior.
preserved_nonaccepted_attempts.correction: The header-value explanation in independent-ordinary-ope-v1-review.json is superseded. The single route accepts true and 1 through env_flag::truthy. The batch header removal causes both refused attempts.

limits: These ordinary operations support their observed key, value, count, and memory-read results. They do not prove every possible concurrent schedule.
The small operation set is not a latency or throughput benchmark. No before/after speed claim follows.
The status pressure-relief ordering change receives source review; these small homes do not exercise a host-pressure threshold crossing.
The documented per-field conflict rule leaves an unproved mixed peer unchanged; the review does not assume exclusive peer-key ownership.
No primary or archive access occurs in this review.
